scope: Apply time and next-price measures to10 as-of origins in existing November/April cases; no fitting, new labels, network or changes to candidate.

input_semantics.60: saved DG endpoint export, not exact software truth
input_semantics.90: saved DG endpoint export, software discrepancies unresolved
input_semantics.120: previously derived offline EMA series, not new software values
input_semantics.daily: saved DG daily values with three-decimal DIF rounding

definitions.time: (selected old DIF high-current DIF)/(current DIF-previous DIF), only if positive numerator and positive velocity; no abs or rounding. Constant velocity assumption only.
definitions.price: next completed-bar close yielding DIF equality to same target under saved EMA12/26; strictly above equality would cross old high under hypothesis.
definitions.day_equivalent: periods divided by observed usual completed bars per day 60:4,90:3,120:2,daily:1; not forecast wall-clock duration.
definitions.pre_activation: Nov13 120 has one red bar. Historical targets are prospective budgets only; minimum two bars unchanged and no active reference is imputed.
